summary: This bill establishes a national program within the Environmental Protection Agency to reduce health risks from indoor air contaminants by funding research, developing guidelines, providing assistance, and certifying healthy buildings, with a specific focus on improving indoor air quality in schools and childcare facilities.

scores.thoughts: This bill is primarily focused on improving indoor air quality and reducing exposure to indoor air contaminants. While it mentions supporting building resilience against extreme weather events and other consequences of climate change in one paragraph (Section 3(b)(14)) and mitigating health risks from indoor air contaminants due to more frequent extreme weather events and other consequences of climate change in another (Section 6(b)(2)), these are secondary to the main goal of indoor air quality. The bill's core purpose is not environmental protection in the broader sense, but rather public health within buildings.
